description: Address code review issues: (1) Fix fire-and-forget process kick-off with error handling and staleness detection, (2) Add SSRF protection to scrapeProduct direct fetch path, (3) Verify product_details schema has additionalProperties:false, (4) Add OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL env var.
steps: Fix fire-and-forget in apps/web/src/app/ugc/page.tsx: await the process POST, handle errors, add 30-second staleness detection
Add SSRF protection to scrapeProduct() in apps/web/src/lib/ugc/orchestrate.ts: validate hostname, reject private IPs, reject non-http/https protocols
Verify product_details schema in orchestrate.ts has additionalProperties: false (already present, confirm)
Add OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL env var to apps/web/src/lib/assets/image-gen.ts with default 'dall-e-3'
acceptance_criteria: Process POST is awaited and failures show an error message to the user
Staleness detection shows a message if status hasn't changed in 30+ seconds
scrapeProduct rejects private/reserved hostnames and non-http/https protocols
product_details schema has additionalProperties: false at top level
Image generation model is configurable via OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL env var
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web typecheck
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web test
